_about: The Microsoft Store listing for Vesopa Loyalty's first release (9N6VWPJ25VPH). The first submission has to be typed into Partner Center -- the draft opened by reserving the name refuses a PUT (400) and a fresh POST is refused while it exists (409). This is what was typed, kept so the next person starts from it. Every paragraph is one line: Partner Center shows each newline as a line break. Updated 2026-09-13 after the app was changed to ask which venue it is: the native builds had a venue compiled in, which made one Store listing permanently one venue's app.

submission.notesForCertification:
Vesopa Loyalty is the customer-facing loyalty app for venues that use the Vesopa EPOS till system. It is not a general-purpose app: a person uses it as a MEMBER OF A PARTICULAR VENUE'S loyalty scheme, so it asks which venue before anything else.

TO REVIEW IT, please follow these three steps in order. A demonstration venue is set up and waiting.

STEP 1 — the venue.
The first screen is "Which venue?". Enter exactly:

    vesopa-test

and press Continue. (Pasting https://menu.vesopaepos.com/app/vesopa-test/ works too.) The app then shows the sign-in screen for "The Vesopa Kitchen".

STEP 2 — the email address.
Enter:

    manager@vesopa.co.uk

and press "Email me a code".

STEP 3 — the code.
The app emails a six-digit code, and the reviewer cannot read that mailbox, so a standing code has been left in place for certification. It is supplied on the line marked "certification sign-in code" with this submission. Type it into the six-digit box and press Sign in.

You will then see the member's card (a code the venue's till scans), their points, the Activity list, the Account section and the Venue page. Tapping the card turns it over. The bell at the top right opens the venue's news.

ABOUT THE APP

It talks only to the Vesopa back office over HTTPS (menu.vesopaepos.com). It declares the internetClient capability and nothing else. It handles no payment details of any kind: points are applied by the venue's till, never by this app.

Windows notifications are delivered through WNS using the package identity of this submission. If notifications are not yet configured at review time, messages still appear inside the app — that is by design, not a fault.

listing.description:
Your loyalty card for the venues you already go to — always on you, never in the bottom of a bag.

When you first open the app it asks which venue you are joining. Enter the code your venue gave you, or paste the link to its app, and it remembers. Everything after that is your card at that venue: its name, its colours, its news.

Show the code at the till and your points go on straight away. Turn the card over to see what those points are worth and how close you are to being able to spend them.

Every visit is listed. Tap one and it opens out: what you spent, what you earned, and the balance it left behind — so a number on a card is always something you can explain.

News and offers from the venue arrive in the app, with pictures and video, and as Windows notifications so you do not miss the ones that matter. Nothing is lost if you would rather not have notifications: every message is still waiting in the app.

Sign in the way your venue offers — an emailed code, a texted code, a password, a passkey using your face or fingerprint, or your Vesopa account. Your venue chooses what it offers; you choose which you use.

Vesopa Loyalty works with venues running the Vesopa EPOS till system. You need a venue code and a membership to sign in — ask at the venue, or join in the app with your email address if the venue allows it.
features: One app for any Vesopa venue — enter its code once
Your card as a scannable code, with points and tier
Turn the card over for what your points are worth
Every visit itemised — spend, points earned, balance after
Venue news and offers, with pictures and video
Sign in with a code, a password, a passkey or your Vesopa account
